subject.title: feat(cli): improve editor handoffs for agents and humans

question: Should `crabbox open --json` and the exact `crabbox/editor-handoff/v1` fields become the supported public automation contract for editor handoffs?
rationale: The branch creates a durable user-facing CLI schema and lifecycle promise; tests can validate encoding, but maintainers must own the long-term contract and compatibility policy.

options.title: Adopt the v1 handshake
options.body: Accept the documented schema after live proof and a green Go check demonstrate the complete foreground handoff behavior.

options.title: Keep human output only
options.body: Retain the readability improvements but remove the JSON flag until the automation contract is designed and sponsored separately.

options.title: Revise the contract first
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers narrow or rename fields and define versioning or deprecation expectations before release.

recommendation.title: Adopt the v1 handshake
recommendation.body: Accept the documented schema after live proof and a green Go check demonstrate the complete foreground handoff behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current editor-handoff feature and are best positioned to decide whether its follow-up JSON schema is a supported contract.
